You know, I was just thinking about how unpredictable spring weather can be - one day it's sunny, the next it's pouring rain. Makes planning outdoor activities quite the adventure!

Anyway, to your question about those plays - both "The Cocktail Party" and "The Family Reunion" were written by T.S. Eliot, the famous Anglo-American poet and playwright. He wrote these verse dramas in the 1930s and 1940s, exploring themes of guilt, redemption, and spiritual awakening.

Answer: T.S. Eliot
